name: saturn
title: Saturn
description: Bookmarks are text. Memory is visual. Search and save websites captured by the Saturn macOS app.
author: sachindabas

commands.name: search-links
commands.title: Search Bookmarks
commands.subtitle: Saturn
commands.description: Search bookmarks saved in Saturn by title, tag, or page text. Assign a global hotkey in Raycast Settings → Shortcuts.

commands.name: browse-collections
commands.title: Browse Collections
commands.subtitle: Saturn
commands.description: Browse your Saturn collections and open a saved bookmark directly.

commands.name: save-link
commands.title: Save to Saturn
commands.subtitle: Saturn
commands.description: Save the frontmost browser page to Saturn. Opened from Saturn with ⌘B, or assign a global hotkey in Raycast Settings → Shortcuts.

scripts.test:app: node test/tokenizer-parity.mjs && node test/page-text-fixtures.mjs && node test/app-modules-fixtures.mjs
